BIQAI-FULL:v8p308#s079/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p308#s079/r1.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p308#s079/r1.claim: The surah’s purpose is to establish resurrection and the gathering, displaying humanity’s final fate after the preceding surahs’ full exposition; its oaths show the matter has reached its decisive climax.

ELMALILI:79:6-26#2/r21.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:79:6-26#2/r21.speaker: author
ELMALILI:79:6-26#2/r21.claim: After his magicians lost, Pharaoh sent collectors through the cities to assemble his army and elite, as described in al-Shuʿarāʾ.
ELMALILI:79:6-26#2/r21.anchor: Onun üzerine mahşerini topladı ibtidâ sâhirleri toplayıp mağlub olduktan sonra Sûre-i Şu‘arâ’da فَأَرْسَلَ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ [26/53] âyetiyle beyan olunduğu üzere

BURSEVI:v10p250/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p250/r1.speaker: الراغب
BURSEVI:v10p250/r1.claim: Al-Rāghib glosses adbara as turning away and presenting one's back.
BURSEVI:v10p250/r1.anchor: قال الراغب : أدبر أي اعرض وولى دبره

BURSEVI:v10p250/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p250/r2.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p250/r2.claim: Pharaoh's striving against the sign came from defiance and obstinacy, not belief that it could truly be matched.
BURSEVI:v10p250/r2.anchor: يجتهد في معارضة الآية تمردا وعنادا لا اعتقادا بأنها يمكن معارضتها

BURSEVI:v10p250/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p250/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p250/r3.claim: His effort was a false pretext to evade the gathering or court.

BURSEVI:v10p250/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p250/r4.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p250/r4.claim: Grammatically, “striving” is a circumstantial qualifier of the subject of “turned away,” meaning he hurried and exerted himself.
BURSEVI:v10p250/r4.anchor: وهو حال من فاعل أدبر بمعنى مسرعا مجتهدا

BURSEVI:v10p250/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p250/r5.speaker: الكشاف
BURSEVI:v10p250/r5.claim: Al-Kashshāf pictures Pharaoh fleeing in terror and running quickly when he saw the serpent.
BURSEVI:v10p250/r5.anchor: وفي "الكشاف" لما رأى الثعبان أدبر مرعوبا يسرع في مشيته

BURSEVI:v10p250/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p250/r6.speaker: الحسن
BURSEVI:v10p250/r6.claim: Al-Ḥasan describes Pharaoh as a rash, impulsive man.
BURSEVI:v10p250/r6.anchor: قال الحسن رحمه الله كان رجلا طياشا

BURSEVI:v10p250/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p250/r7.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p250/r7.claim: He reads “he gathered” as Pharaoh assembling the sorcerers and their devices, linking this to another account of Pharaoh gathering his plot.

BURSEVI:v10p250/r8.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p250/r8.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p250/r8.claim: Alternatively, Pharaoh may have summoned all the people and made the announcement himself at the gathering or through a herald.
BURSEVI:v10p250/r8.anchor: فنادى} بنفسه في المقام الذي اجتمعوا فيه ، معه أو بواسطة المنادي

QASHANI:79:18-26/r5.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:79:18-26/r5.speaker: author
QASHANI:79:18-26/r5.claim: He pursued satanic schemes and psychical tricks against Moses, was expelled from the holy presence, and his veil grew.
QASHANI:79:18-26/r5.anchor: يسعى } في دفع موسى بالمكايد الشيطانية والحيل النفسانية فرد عن جناب القدس مطرودا وازداد حجابه

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p329/r2.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p329/r2.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p329/r2.claim: Pharaoh gathered his people and soldiers, then called out to them.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p329/r2.anchor: فحشر} فجمع قومه وجنوده {فنادى} لما اجتمعوا.

BINTSHATI:v1p147/r2.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p147/r2.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v1p147/r2.claim: The omitted object of “gathered” is clear from the word’s explicit sense of assembling a crowd, so the text needs no stated object.
BINTSHATI:v1p147/r2.anchor: لم يصرح القرآن بمفعول حشر، ولكن لفظ الحضر بما له من دلالة صريحة على الجمع المزدحم، يغني عن ذكر المحذوف.

BINTSHATI:v1p147/r3.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p147/r3.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v1p147/r3.claim: In Arabic, ḥashr is used chiefly for mustering a crowd amid pressure or hardship.
BINTSHATI:v1p147/r3.anchor: وقلما يستعمل الحشر - لغة - لإلا في موضع الحشد والشدة،

BINTSHATI:v1p147/r4.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p147/r4.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v1p147/r4.claim: The Qur’an most often uses ḥashr for the Last Day, calling it the Day of Gathering in more than thirty places.
BINTSHATI:v1p147/r4.anchor: والقرآن الكريم، يستعمله غالباً في اليوم الآخر، وقد سمي "يوم الحشر" في أكثر من ثلاثين موضعاً،

BINTSHATI:v1p147/r5.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p147/r5.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v1p147/r5.claim: Other worldly Qur’anic uses include Solomon’s mustered troops, the first gathering of expelled People of the Book, David’s gathered birds, and five accounts involving Pharaoh and Moses.
BINTSHATI:v1p147/r5.anchor: أما استعماله في الحياة الدنيا فجاء منه في القرآن: وآية النمل 17: {وَحُشِرَ لِسُلَيْمَانَ جُنُودُهُ} .

BINTSHATI:v1p147/r6.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p147/r6.speaker: الزمخشري
BINTSHATI:v1p147/r6.claim: Al-Zamakhshari suggests Pharaoh ordered a caller to announce his message, but the author says the text does not support that reading.
BINTSHATI:v1p147/r6.anchor: لكن الزمخشري ذكر فيه إحتمالين: أن يكون فرعون "قد أمر منادياً فنادى في الناس بذلك".

BIQAI-FULL:v8p315/r7.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p315/r7.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p315/r7.claim: His turning away led him to gather the magicians by choice or force and add his soldiers to them.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p315/r7.anchor: جمع السحرة طوعا وكرها وزاد عليهم أيضا جنوده

BIQAI-FULL:v8p315/r8.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p315/r8.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p315/r8.claim: He called out in the gathering through a herald whose words represented his own.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p315/r8.anchor: أي في المجامع { فقال } أي مناديه الذي لا يشك أنه عنه

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p79/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p79/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p79/r1.claim: Pharaoh’s “turning away” is figurative: he refused the caller’s invitation, as in the example of Musaylima rejecting faith.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p79/r1.anchor: والإدبار والسعي مستعملان في معنييهما المجازيين فإن حقيقة الإدبار هو المشي إلى الجهة التي هي خلف الماشي

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p79/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p79/r2.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p79/r2.claim: The Prophet warned Musaylima that if he turned away, God would have him killed.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p79/r2.anchor: قول النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم لمسيلمة لما أبى الإيمان : ( ولئن أدبرت ليعقرنك الله )

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p79/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p79/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p79/r3.claim: Pharaoh’s striving is figurative for his strenuous efforts to keep people from listening to Moses and to gather magicians against what he mistook for sorcery.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p79/r3.anchor: وأما السعي فحقيقته : شدة المشي ، وهو هنا مستعار للحرص والاجتهاد في أمره الناس بعدم الإصغاء لكلام موسى

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p79/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p79/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p79/r6.claim: Another permissible reading takes “turned away” and “strove” literally: Pharaoh left the gathering in anger and walked quickly in an angry, rejecting manner.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p79/r6.anchor: ويجوز أن يكون { أدبر } على حقيقته ، أي ترك ذلك المجمع بأن قام معرضا إعلانا بغضبه على موسى

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p79/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p79/r8.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p79/r8.claim: The object of “he gathered” is omitted because it is obvious: the inhabitants of his city, from every class.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p79/r8.anchor: وحذف مفعول ( حشر ) لظهوره لأن الذين يحشرون هم أهل مدينته من كل صنف

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p433/r2.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p433/r2.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p433/r2.claim: Pharaoh gathered the people of his kingdom and called out that he was their highest lord.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p433/r2.anchor: وقوله فحشر معناه: جمع أهل مملكته ثم ناداهم بقوله: أنا ربكم الأعلى

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p433/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p433/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p433/r3.claim: Ibn ʿAbbas says the verse’s sequence means he called first, then gathered the people.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p433/r3.anchor: وروي عن ابن عباس أنه قال: المعنى: فنادى فحشر

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p315#2/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p315#2/r2.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p315#2/r2.claim: The phrase “he gathered and called out” means that Pharaoh called out among his people.

JISHUMI:v10p7268/r10.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7268/r10.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7268/r10.claim: Ḥashr is gathering from every direction; al-ḥāshir gathers people, and the Day of Gathering is the Resurrection.
JISHUMI:v10p7268/r10.anchor: والحشر: الجمع من كل جهة، ومنه: الحاشر الذي يجمع الناس، ومنه: يوم الحشر يوم القيامة

JISHUMI:v10p7271/r10.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7271/r10.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7271/r10.claim: Jishumi argues that human acts originate from the servants themselves, citing Pharaoh's transgression, denial, turning away, and calling out.

MUQATIL:79:15-26/r12.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:79:15-26/r12.speaker: author
MUQATIL:79:15-26/r12.claim: Pharaoh gathered the Copts and called out.
MUQATIL:79:15-26/r12.anchor: ثم أتى بهم { فحشر فنادى } [آية: 23] يقول حشر القبط { فقال أنا ربكم الأعلى } [آية: 24]

NAHHAS:v5p143/r14.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p143/r14.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v5p143/r14.claim: The object is omitted: Pharaoh gathered his people, as Ibn Zayd explains, and then called out among them.
NAHHAS:v5p143/r14.anchor: وحذف المفعول أي وحشر قومه كما قال ابن زيد جمع قومه ( فنادى ) فيهم

QURTUBI-FULL:79:22-26/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:79:22-26/r5.speaker: قيل
QURTUBI-FULL:79:22-26/r5.claim: He gathered his companions so they could protect him from the serpent.
QURTUBI-FULL:79:22-26/r5.anchor: { فحشر } أي جمع أصحابه ليمنعوه منها.

QURTUBI-FULL:79:22-26/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:79:22-26/r6.speaker: قيل
QURTUBI-FULL:79:22-26/r6.claim: He gathered his soldiers for battle and sorcerers to challenge Moses.
QURTUBI-FULL:79:22-26/r6.anchor: وقيل: جمع جنوده للقتال والمحاربة، والسحرة للمعارضة.

QURTUBI-FULL:79:22-26/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:79:22-26/r7.speaker: قيل
QURTUBI-FULL:79:22-26/r7.claim: Another view says he assembled the people to attend.

QURTUBI-FULL:79:22-26/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:79:22-26/r8.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:79:22-26/r8.claim: He called out in a loud voice.
QURTUBI-FULL:79:22-26/r8.anchor: { فنادى } أي قال لهم بصوت عال

RAZI-FULL:v31p39#2/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p39#2/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v31p39#2/r1.claim: One reading of ثم أدبر يسعى says Pharaoh fled in terror after seeing the serpent; al-Hasan calls him reckless and quick-moving.
RAZI-FULL:v31p39#2/r1.anchor: أنه لما رأى الثعبان أدبر مرعوبا يسعى يسرع في مشيه ، قال الحسن

RAZI-FULL:v31p39#2/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p39#2/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v31p39#2/r2.claim: A second reading says Pharaoh turned away from Moses while striving to plot against him.
RAZI-FULL:v31p39#2/r2.anchor: تولى عن موسى يسعى ويجتهد في مكايدته

RAZI-FULL:v31p39#2/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p39#2/r3.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v31p39#2/r3.claim: A third reading takes أدبر as began to act or proceed, like أقبل يفعل; أدبر avoids describing Pharaoh as approaching.
RAZI-FULL:v31p39#2/r3.anchor: أن يكون المعنى ، ثم أقبل يسعى

RAZI-FULL:v31p39#3/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p39#3/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v31p39#3/r1.claim: Pharaoh gathered the magicians as in al-Shuara, then proclaimed his claim at their gathering, sent an announcer to proclaim it, or addressed the people himself.
RAZI-FULL:v31p39#3/r1.anchor: فحشر فجمع السحرة كقوله : { فأرسل فرعون فى المدائن حاشرين }

STUDYQURAN:79:15/r14.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:79:15/r14.speaker: most
STUDYQURAN:79:15/r14.claim: Most commentators take Pharaoh's gathering and proclamation as assembling the people to declare his sovereignty.
STUDYQURAN:79:15/r14.anchor: Most say this verse indicates that Pharaoh gathered all the people to declare his sovereignty.

STUDYQURAN:79:15/r15.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:79:15/r15.speaker: R
STUDYQURAN:79:15/r15.claim: Others connect the gathering to 26:53, taking it as Pharaoh summoning his people to pursue the Israelites.
STUDYQURAN:79:15/r15.anchor: Others relate this verse to 26:53: Then Pharaoh sent marshalers to the cities, in which case it refers to Pharaoh’s summoning his people

TABATABAI:79:23-26/r2.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:79:23-26/r2.speaker: قيل
TABATABAI:79:23-26/r2.claim: A reported view says Pharaoh gathered the magicians, citing the gathering of summoners and his assembling his plot elsewhere.
TABATABAI:79:23-26/r2.anchor: وقيل المراد بالحشر جمع السحرة لقوله تعالى فأرسل فرعون في المدائن حاشرين

TABATABAI:79:23-26/r3.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:79:23-26/r3.speaker: author
TABATABAI:79:23-26/r3.claim: The cited verses do not prove that the gathering here has the same meaning as the gathering there.
TABATABAI:79:23-26/r3.anchor: وفيه أنه لا دليل على كون المراد بالحشر في هذه الآية هو عين المراد بالحشر والجمع في تينك الآيتين

TABRISI:79:15-24/r21.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:79:15-24/r21.speaker: author
TABRISI:79:15-24/r21.claim: Pharaoh gathered his people and soldiers and called out to them.
TABRISI:79:15-24/r21.anchor: { فحشر } أي فجمع قومه وجنوده { فنادى } فيهم

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:79:20-25/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:79:20-25/r4.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:79:20-25/r4.claim: Pharaoh gathered the magicians and his people, then called out.

TAB-FULL:v24p83#2/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p83#2/r1.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v24p83#2/r1.claim: Pharaoh assembled his people and followers and called to them that he was the highest lord, above every other lord; he was a foolish liar.
TAB-FULL:v24p83#2/r1.anchor: قال ابن زيد، في قوله: {فحشر فنادى} [النازعات: 23] قال: صرخ وحشر قومه

TAB-FULL:v24p83#2/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p83#2/r2.speaker: ابن زيد
TAB-FULL:v24p83#2/r2.claim: Ibn Zayd says Pharaoh cried out and gathered his people; when they assembled, he declared himself their highest lord, after which God seized him as punishment for both lives.
TAB-FULL:v24p83#2/r2.anchor: قال ابن زيد، في قوله: {فحشر فنادى} [النازعات: 23] قال: صرخ وحشر قومه

WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p188#4/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p188#4/r2.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p188#4/r2.claim: He gathered his people and soldiers, then called out.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p188#4/r2.anchor: وهو قوله تعالى: {فحشر فنادى} فجمع قومه، وجنوده فنادى

SAMIN-DURR:79:23/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:79:23/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:79:23/r1.claim: The objects of both verbs are omitted, either because only the action matters or with the understood sense that Pharaoh gathered his people and called to them.
SAMIN-DURR:79:23/r1.anchor: لم يذكر مفعولاهما؛ إذ المراد فعل ذلك، أو يكون التقدير: فحشر قومه فناداهم

SAMIN-DURR:79:23/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:79:23/r2.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:79:23/r2.claim: The following فقال explains what the calling consisted of.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p398/r13.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p398/r13.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p398/r13.claim: Pharaoh gathered the magicians and officials, then addressed the assembly where they met.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p398/r13.anchor: فحشر: أي جمع السحرة وأرباب دولته، فنادى: أي قام فيهم خطيبا

ALUSI-FULL:v30p30#2/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p30#2/r5.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v30p30#2/r5.claim: Alusi says the fleeing-serpent account does not fit if this comes after the customary gathering of magicians; if before it, the delay signaled by ثم is unclear. It may instead stress how startling his frightened flight was, or use أدبر ironically for ‘began’, signaling ruin.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p30#2/r5.anchor: أن هذا إن كان بعد حشر السحرة للمعارضة كما هو المشهور فلا تظهر صحة إرادته ههنا إذا أريد بالحشر بعد حشرهم

ALUSI-FULL:v30p30#3/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p30#3/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v30p30#3/r1.claim: The most supported meaning is that Pharaoh gathered the magicians, as in the accounts of his sending out summoners and then assembling his plotters.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p30#3/r1.anchor: أي فجمع السحرة لقوله تعالى فأرسل فرعون في المدائن حاشرين وقوله سبحانه فتولى فرعون فجمع كيده ثم أتى

ALUSI-FULL:v30p30#3/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p30#3/r2.speaker: قيل
ALUSI-FULL:v30p30#3/r2.claim: Another view says Pharaoh gathered his troops; it may also mean that he gathered his subjects.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p30#3/r2.anchor: وقيل جمع جنوده وجوز أن يراد أهل مملكته

ALUSI-FULL:v30p30#3/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p30#3/r3.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v30p30#3/r3.claim: Pharaoh proclaimed his words in the assembly himself or through a herald.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p30#3/r3.anchor: فنادى في المجمع نفسه أو بواسطة المنادى

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p21#3/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p21#3/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p21#3/r1.claim: He gathered his people and troops, then called out once they had assembled.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p21#3/r1.anchor: فحشر أي فجمع قومه وجنوده فنادى لما اجتمعوا

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p197/r15.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p197/r15.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p197/r15.claim: One explanation is that Pharaoh assembled the sorcerers for a contest and summoned his army to fight.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p197/r15.anchor: أحدهما : حشر السحرة للمعارضة ، ونادى جنده للمحاربة

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p197/r16.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p197/r16.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p197/r16.claim: Alternatively, he gathered the people to attend and addressed them.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p197/r16.anchor: حشر الناس للحضور ونادى أي خطب فيهم

NASAFI-FULL:v4p315/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p315/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p315/r1.claim: Pharaoh gathered the magicians and his troops.

NASAFI-FULL:v4p315/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p315/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p315/r2.claim: He called out at the place where those gathered with him had assembled.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p315/r2.anchor: فى إلى مقام الذى اجتمعوا فيه معه
